Grading / Calculation System Overall percentage for all graded subjects taken. Pass = 60%.

Total score of the best 4 subjects by referring to the ‘standard score’ including Language Arts and Mathematics as awarded on the official final CSAT awarded by the KICE. 

Korean History, English and Vocational Education stream subjects cannot be included in the calculation. 

Evidence of completion from Upper Secondary Certificate must be submitted.
